claims.statement: 1952-04-25 city council election returned 378 councillors, including 118 Liberal, 16 Democratic Nationalist and 148 independent members according to contemporary press reports.
claims.note: Two newspaper articles may derive from the same Ministry of Interior count. The digitized city table sums to 428, so verify original print.

claims.statement: Municipal and provincial council elections were held on separate dates in April and May 1952, with wartime geographic exclusions.
The election was politically associated with the constitutional confrontation, but a presidential direct order to specific councils is not established.
